arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Critical Strike Damage is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} against {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} enemies and your {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Critical Strike Chance is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|%x|]{/c} against {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} enemies.

Killing an enemy with a Critical Strike grants both bonuses against all enemies as well as {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.
